purpose: Actual mobile-landscape body-fullscreen pause captures with native controls visible; longest subtitle selected by current text length plus both frozen Figure frames.

longestSubtitle.text: 第一个黑或白传出奇偶，后面的人就能用眼前帽子和已知答案，补上自己缺的那一顶。

limitations: Chromium touch simulation and Fullscreen API, not physical-phone testing.
A paused controls-visible view is sampled, not every device or every possible controls theme.
